no_rooms: No rooms yet. Add one to get started.
live_hint: Every change is applied to the real lights. Click one to open its controls.
review_hint: Nothing is touched. Switch to live mode to set the lights and see it.
light_treatment: Each light can take the scene, be switched off, or be left alone.
group_cycle: A group cannot contain itself, directly or through another group.
zone_overlap: A light can only be in one zone of a room.
cycle_hint: Each press moves one place down, then wraps.
all_scenes_used: Every scene in this room is already in the list.
import_hint: Home Assistant's own scenes. A scene covering several rooms becomes one scene in each, holding only that room's lights.
nothing_to_import: No Home Assistant scenes to import.
skipped_note: Not imported, because they are in no room of yours:
update_available: A new version of this page is available.
waiting_for_events: Nothing yet. Press a switch, or let a mode change.
curve_hint: What the sun implies for this room across today. The line is brightness; the band behind it is colour temperature.
sending_now: What each light would be sent now
pick_a_room: Pick a room to see its curve.
no_modes: No modes yet. Add one to put the whole house into a film, a night out or a party.
seen_hint: What each switch has published, and what it was read as. A value read as nothing is one this switch has no word for: add it to the matching list of values, or have the switch treat any change as a press.
no_rules: No actions yet. An action says what one room does in one of this mode's states, or what the house does with no room at all.
no_scenes: No scenes yet. A scene is this room's lights, set the way you want them.
discard_changes: There are unsaved changes on this screen. Leave without saving?
save_as_preset: Keep this colour under a name
preset_name: What should this colour be called?
no_colour_to_keep: This light has no colour of its own in this scene.
adaptive_scene_hint: The room's own default. Every light in it, following the sun, unless you say otherwise.
reload_frontend_missing: The dashboard card is not being served ({reason}). Reloading will not help; check that the integration loaded.
guide_missing: The guide could not be loaded.
reload_frontend_hint: Drops the cached copy of this integration's scripts and of the page that loads them, then loads it again. Use it when an update is installed but the page is still the old one, and on a phone, where there is no hard refresh.
about_blurb: One integration for adaptive lighting, scenes, switches and house-wide modes.
discard_changes_hint: What was changed on this screen will be lost.
steps_hint: Each step is a share of whatever brightness the effect is given, a time to get there, and a time to stay. They play in order, and start again if the effect repeats.
triggers_hint: Any one of these turns the lights on. While at least one is active they stay on; when the last one clears they go off after the delay above.
simulation_rules_hint: All of these have to hold before a simulation may run at all. The switch runs one anyway, for checking the setup.
room_simulation_rules_hint: Added to the house-wide rules rather than replacing them: both have to hold before this room takes part.
day_strip_hint: When the clock allows it. Green is open, red is not — other rules still apply.
night_lights_off_hint: Ask every room to go dark, as night mode would.
card_missing: The dashboard card did not load, so rooms cannot be shown here.
room_rules_hint: Rules for the whole room: all of these have to hold before any trigger may act. Each trigger can add rules of its own.
trigger_rules_hint: Checked when this sensor goes active, on top of the room's rules. The hallway sensor that lights the living room only while night mode is off, say.
act_night_off_waiting: Night turn-off waiting for the room to empty
act_light_joined_scene: Light switched on, joins the scene
act_mode_switched_off: Mode is switched off; noted only
